subject: Evaluation kickoff and trial plan — Acme Retail
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acmeretail.com>, Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation kickoff and trial plan — Acme Retail

Hi Sarah / Daniel,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — really helpful to hear more about Acme's search and personalization use cases and the throughput constraints on your checkout experiments. As a quick recap from our discovery call:

- Primary goal: reduce search latency and improve relevance for the US retail site (target P95 < 250ms for search responses)
- Success criteria: +8% clickthrough on recommended items, <250ms P95 overall, and reproducible prompt sets for evaluation
- Typical traffic: peak 60 RPS for search, 10 RPS for personalization calls during promotions
- Security: SOC 2 and KMS requirement noted

Next step: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff where we’ll run through the trial plan, define success criteria, review the prompt set/evals, and schedule the technical deep-dive for integration and capacity planning. Proposed agenda:

1) Trial scope & length (recommended 2–4 weeks)
2) Success metrics and measurement plan
3) Prompt set and evaluation harness (we’ll ask for sample prompts/datasets)
4) Integration checklist & technical owners (SE deep-dive follow-up)
5) Timing & next steps

Available slots (PDT) next week — please pick one that works and we'll send a calendar invite:
- Tue 2026-03-31 10:00–11:00
- Tue 2026-03-31 14:00–15:00
- Wed 2026-04-01 09:00–10:00

I’ve attached a short evaluation plan outline (redwood-eval-plan.pdf) and a draft NDA if you want to get that started (acme-nda-draft.pdf). Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Connor (cc) will join the kickoff for the technical portion. Let me know if you prefer an earlier/later date or if we should loop in anyone else from your infra/security teams.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-eval-plan.pdf, acme-nda-draft.pdf

From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acmeretail.com>

Cc: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@acmeretail.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff and trial plan — Acme Retail

Thanks Marissa — great summary and appreciate the detail.

We'd like to get the kickoff on the calendar. Tue 2026-03-31 14:00–15:00 PDT works best for the team here. I'll invite my manager (Daniel) and our infra lead may join depending on the agenda.

Couple of quick asks before the kickoff:
- Can you share the sample prompt set format you typically use?
- On SOC 2/KMS: can we get the SOC 2 letter and a brief note on KMS integrations?

If it helps, here’s a calendar link to block: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

See you on the 31st.
—Sarah
Sarah Jensen
Head of Personalization | Acme Retail
Phone: (212) 555-9876

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff and trial plan — Acme Retail

Perfect — I’ll send the invite for Tue 03/31 14:00–15:00 PDT. Calendar invite and Google Meet link will be attached to the invite.

Answers to your asks:
- Prompt set: attached is the eval plan (redwood-eval-plan.pdf) — section 2 includes the prompt format we prefer (CSV with columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, context, expected_behavior, evaluation_labels). If you can share a small sample (50–200 prompts) that will be enough to get initial baseline metrics.
- SOC 2 / KMS: attaching the SOC 2 letter excerpt and a short KMS integration note in the eval plan. If your security team wants a deeper session, we can schedule a focused call with our security lead.

Connor — could you confirm whether we should ask Acme for a sample dataset (click logs or anonymized event samples) before the kickoff or if the sample prompt set alone is enough to run the baseline?

Thanks,
Marissa

Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff and trial plan — Acme Retail

Hi Sarah — quick note from the SE side. For the baseline run we can work with just the sample prompt set (50–200 prompts) plus a small anonymized clickstream sample if you have it; the clickstream helps with offline evaluation for recommendation relevance, but it's not required to get started. If you do share logs, please anonymize user ids and remove PII.

Also: two items for the kickoff so I can come prepared:
- Which environment do you want us to use for the eval (hosted Redwood API vs. Dedicated trial capacity)? If you have governance constraints, we can default to a private VPC demo.
- Any rate/throughput limits we should simulate (e.g., steady 15 RPS, spikes to 60 RPS)?

Thanks — looking forward to the session.
Connor
Connor O'Brien | Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com

Thanks all — confirmed for Tue 03/31 14:00–15:00 PDT. I’ve shared a 100-item sample prompt set (CSV) with the invite and flagged Daniel to review the NDA. For the environment, we'll start with Hosted API but may request a Dedicated trial if performance looks promising. For throughput, please plan to simulate steady 15 RPS with a 60 RPS spike pattern.

I'll add our infra lead if we need deeper security/infra checks. See you on Tuesday.

Sarah
